title: Core: remove `class_db.h` include from `resource.h`
body:
* Part of #111218 
* Follow up to #116737

Changes:
* Removes the `class_db.h` include in `resource.h` by including it in `resource.cpp` instead.
* All other changes are cascading for the project to compile

This PR reduces the number of files including `class_db.h` to 1538 from 2998 on main. A whopping 48.7% reduction. 

782 of those remaining are direct includers, which means they need it, but that still leaves 756, or about 50%, that can be pruned. 

After this PR, the biggest contributors to the include count are `native_menu.h`, `audio_server.h`, `undo_redo.h`, `physics_server_2d.h`, and `openxr_extension_wrapper.h` (all above 100 each).
